newsitem.title: USA: Belmont Homes sees flat to lower Q4 net.
newsitem.headline: Belmont Homes sees flat to lower Q4 net.

text.p: Belmont Homes Inc said Tuesday that it expects earnings per share for the fourth quarter of 1996 to be equal to or slightly below the $0.33 per share reported for the fourth quarter of last year.
In a release Tuesday the company said increasing costs and competitive conditions at the retail dealer level will "restrain income growth in the fourth quarter of 1996."

Belmont Homes said that Spirit Homes, which it acquired in the fourth quarter of 1995, completed the opening of its second new plant during the third quarter of 1996. Due to the expansion, the company said Spirit increased the size of its labor force, resulting in higher labor costs during the quarter.

The company Tuesday reported net income of $3.36 million, or $0.35 per share, for the third quarter of 1996, compared with net income of $2.6 million, or $0.31 per share, for the third quarter of last year.
